name: Anthem

internationalCoverage.overview: Anthem is a BCBS licensee operating in 14+ states (now branded as Elevance Health). As a BCBS member, Anthem plans have access to the BlueCard PPO and BCBS Global Core programs for international coverage. Anthem tends to have solid international emergency coverage for PPO members.

planDifferences.description: PPO plans cover international emergency and urgent care through the BlueCard/Global Core network at out-of-network rates. HMO plans cover emergencies only. Anthem's BlueCard PPO program is one of the more seamless domestic-to-international coverage bridges.

covered: Emergency room visits via BCBS Global Core

alerts.title: BlueCard PPO Abroad
alerts.message: Show your Anthem Blue Cross card at any BCBS Global Core participating hospital abroad. For non-emergencies, call BCBS Global Core at 1-800-810-BLUE (2583) first to find a network provider.

alerts.title: Out-of-Network Rates Apply
alerts.message: International care is billed at out-of-network rates, even through Global Core. This means higher deductibles and coinsurance than in-network US care. If you go outside the Global Core network abroad, you'll pay upfront and file for reimbursement.

supplementalInsurance.details: Recommended. Anthem's BCBS Global Core access is decent for emergencies, but medical evacuation isn't guaranteed in all plans, and out-of-network rates can leave you with significant out-of-pocket costs.

questionsToAsk: Does my Anthem plan participate in BCBS Global Core?
What are my out-of-network deductible and coinsurance for international claims?
Is medical evacuation included in my plan?
Can I get direct billing at Global Core hospitals abroad?
How do I pre-authorize non-emergency international care?
